introductions.text: Atlantic Salmon (Arroyo de la Laguna, near Sunol) · failed
Smallmouth Bass (Laguna Lake at San Luis) · established
Pumpkinseed (Below Laguna Dam E. & W. sides of Colorado River) · established
Common Carp (just below Laguna Dam on W. Colorado River) · established
Bluegill (just below Laguna Dam on the west side of the Colorado River) · established
Largemouth Bass (Below Laguna Dam on E. & W. side of Colorado River) · established
White Crappie (below Laguna Dam on W. side of Colorado River) · established
Threadfin Shad (Below Laguna dam, westside of Colorado River) · established
Mohave Tui Chub (Lion Country Safari, Laguna Hills, Orange County [Safari does not exist anymore]) · failed
Western Mosquitofish (mouth of Aliso Creek at Hwy 1, 4.5 mi S of Laguna) · established
Largemouth Bass (mouth Aliso Cr., ca 7.2 km SE Laguna Beach) · established
Blue Tilapia (below Laguna Dam (just a few miles northeast of Yuma, Arizona) · established
Yellowfin Goby (Point Mugu Naval Air Station, Laguna Road bridge, west side, stretched seine from shore to submerged mussel beds) · established
